## Qualify Substack Newsletters for B2B Sponsorships & Extract Top Posts Engagement
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Substack Newsletter Leads, Authors & Posts Scraper: Engagement & Sponsorship Data](https://apify.com/storeintel/substack-newsletter-leads-posts-scraper)

Extract Substack publication sponsor leads (author bio, Twitter/X handle, paid subscription status, average reactions & comments) and full post archives.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Substack Newsletter B2B Sponsorship Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/substack-newsletter-b2b-sponsorship-leads-scraper)
- [Substack Posts, Reactions & Engagement Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/substack-top-posts-engagement-metrics-scraper)
- [Substack Paid Newsletter Authors & Socials Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/substack-paid-newsletter-authors-twitter-scraper)
